NFL DFS Projections Week 11: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 12:11 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate: 26.9 DraftKings points at $10,000. He holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 100,000 simulations. Emmett Johnson holds the largest share at 64% for $6,000.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Emmett Johnson (23.1, $6,000), Josh Allen (22.2, $7,700), Dak Prescott (22.0, $6,700) and CeeDee Lamb (21.2, $8,800). Emmett Johnson returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.85 projected points per $1,000. CeeDee Lamb leads the wide receivers at 21.2 for $8,800, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 22.2 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 14.1 for $6,600.

The 10-game slate runs from a 54.5-point total in TEN at DAL down to 37.5 in PIT at PHI. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 12:11 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 100,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 11 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs MIA ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.2 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.2 points clear of Dak Prescott. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.89 projected points per $1,000, 15th of 16 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.2 points with a simulated floor of 9.3 and a ceiling of 41.1, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 16.5-point favorite at home against Miami, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Dak Prescott, DAL vs TEN ($6,700)

Dak Prescott projects 2nd at the position with 22.0 DraftKings points at $6,700, 4th on the main slate overall. The salary works out to 3.29 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 16 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Prescott averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.6 and a ceiling of 40.1, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Justin Herbert, LAC vs NYJ ($5,100)

Justin Herbert projects for 18.6 DraftKings points at $5,100, which works out to 3.65 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 16 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.5 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Herbert averaged 18.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 34.2, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Chargers are a 3-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 43.5.
